subject: Acme POC - access provisioning, success criteria, and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acme.com>; David Kline <david.kline@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: Acme POC - access provisioning, success criteria, and next steps

Thanks for the call earlier — great to align on scope. Quick recap and next steps so we can kick off the POC next week.

High-level success criteria (per today's discussion):
- Achieve >=95% intent-match on ingest pipeline sample (10K records) using Redwood hosted model variant.
- End-to-end latency <=250ms p50 for 512-token sequences in our dedicated sandbox.
- Cost estimate within the threshold you approved in the call (~$X/day for expected volume).
- Integration: SSO login for two engineers + API access for the ingestion service.

Access we need from Acme to provision the sandbox:
1) SAML metadata file or IdP SSO invite (we can do SSO via Okta/Azure AD).
2) IP ranges to allowlist for your outbound requests (we will provide the hostname and port).
3) A primary technical contact for API key distribution and validation (you mentioned David).

Action items / owners:
- Acme (Sarah/David): send SAML metadata file + IP ranges by EOD Wed (2026-09-30).
- Redwood (Marissa/Ben/Dev): provision sandbox, create two SSO invites, generate API key for ingestion service, and share network endpoints. Target completion: Thu 2026-10-01.

Ben / Dev — can you take the provisioning task once Sarah sends the metadata? I'll assign the POC workspace and share credentials via the secure portal. Ben, can you also prepare the POC success criteria doc I attached (POC_success_criteria_v1.pdf) so Acme has one doc to sign off on?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

We captured the success criteria on our side and David will own the integration. I attached the SAML metadata file (ACME_SSO_metadata.xml) and a text file with our public egress IPs (network_ip_ranges.txt).

1) Can you confirm how long the API key will be valid for the POC and whether you can rotate it on our schedule?

We aim to start smoke tests on Mon 2026-10-04. If you can provision before EOD Thu (2026-10-01) we should be good.

Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 11:04:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Acme POC - access provisioning, success criteria, and next steps

Forwarding SAML metadata and IP ranges from Acme. Dev / Ben — please run the provisioning checklist below and update this thread when done.

Provisioning checklist (target: Thu EOD 2026-10-01):
- Create POC workspace (acme-poc-2026-09) and attach the POC_success_criteria_v1.pdf to the workspace.
- Issue two SSO invites for Sarah and David (SAML) and verify login.
- Generate a scoped API key for the ingestion service (label: acme-poc-ingest-2026). Key should be constrained to sandbox workspace and set to expire 60 days by default (we can rotate earlier on request).
- Provide SSL hostname: sandbox-us1.redwood.example.com (add to the allowlist on Acme side) and confirm port 443.
- Configure IP allowlist for outbound callbacks using Acme ranges in network_ip_ranges.txt.
- Share secure link for the API key and add David as the recipient.

Notes: if SSO metadata is missing any attributes, reach out to Sarah immediately. If we need a static IP instead of hostname for their firewall, flag that and we'll request a static egress IP allocation.

Thanks — please reply with status.

-Marissa
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2026 18:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Acme POC - access provisioning, success criteria, and next steps

Completed the provisioning steps this afternoon. Summary: 
- Workspace: acme-poc-2026-09 created and POC_success_criteria_v1.pdf attached.
- SSO: two SAML invites sent to Sarah and David (accepted by David; Sarah pending because of Okta approval flow).
- API key: generated (label: acme-poc-ingest-2026). Shared secure link to David Kline (Doc link: https://redwood-secure.example.com/keys/ACME-POC-INGEST-XXXX). Note: key preview is not in email for security.
- Endpoint: sandbox-us1.redwood.example.com on port 443. Please ask Acme infra to allowlist that hostname. If they prefer IPs, we can request a static egress IP (will take ~2 business days).
- Network: configured callback allowlist to accept Acme ranges from network_ip_ranges.txt.

Next steps for Marissa/Ben: confirm Sarah accepted SSO invite and that David can exercise the API key in a smoke test. If Sarah's Okta admin blocks the invite, we can generate an email-based invite as fallback.

I'll keep the workspace open and monitor for any auth errors.

-Dev
